goal: Add one model while preserving the existing model.
initial_conditions: Fresh virtual workspace containing only the listed fixtures; configuration is inactive until reloaded.

files.docs/models.md: config/models.json is an object with an items array. Preserve existing entries exactly. Each new entry uses name (string), display_name (string), reasoning (boolean), input (array of input-kind strings, e.g. ["text"]), context_window (integer), max_tokens (integer), cost (number). Reload, then eval_probe target="models" input="" returns the active registry. The registry accepts JSON structurally; verify field types yourself against this specification.

steps.content: Add fixture-chat to the model registry, displayed as Fixture Chat. It supports reasoning and text input, context 32768, max output 4096, cost 0. Preserve existing entries; read docs/models.md. Write configuration.
Probe the loaded models and confirm the addition.
